purpose: Provide stage capability composition for already-Current professional process machines without mutating their Current authority carriers in place.
authority_rule: The exact Current professional machine remains authoritative for professional process semantics. This projection owns execution routing only and becomes stale when the bound machine blob or SHA256 drifts.
migration_rule: A future authorized professional-process evolution may move equivalent stage execution requirements into a successor Current machine. Until that transaction, this carrier remains runtime-only.

multi_skill_required_when: multiple material native outputs require different capability owners or authoritative execution surfaces
a specialist or technical capability cannot be collapsed into the general design owner without widening authority
producer execution and required independent review must remain separate
single_owner_allowed_when: one Current callable owner demonstrably covers every active required capability, native output and readback without authority or fidelity loss
owner_set_recompute_triggers: professional stage changes
material decision object or claim changes
required native output, readback or interface handoff changes
selected owner or tool becomes unavailable or insufficient
HOLD release condition activates a new verification route
forbidden_substitutions: research or evidence resolution replaced by unsupported design intuition
domain-native source or readback replaced by presentation derivative
specialist or technical authority replaced by a general design execution owner
independent review replaced by producer self-check
material design dimension dropped only to reduce owner count
composition_readback_requirements: each active required capability role resolves to a Current callable owner or explicit HOLD
each material native output and readback identifies execution and readback ownership
typed handoffs between distinct owners are explicit and accepted before stage closure
omitted supporting capabilities have an explicit N/A or not-triggered reason
